component.name: BuildNotify
component.summary: Watch continuous integration builds from the system tray

description.p: BuildNotify is a CCMenu/CCTray equivalent for Linux. It sits in the system tray and shows the build status of projects on any continuous integration server that publishes a cctray.xml feed, such as GoCD, Jenkins, GitLab or CruiseControl. It can also watch GitHub Actions workflows through the GitHub API.

ul.li: Monitor projects on several CI servers at once
See the overall build status from the tray icon
Open individual project pages from the tray menu
Get notified when builds break, are fixed or keep failing
See the last build time and build label of each project
Run your own script when a build changes
See unreachable servers and their last error in the tray menu
Mute a server or project, or pause notifications for an hour

description.p: The tray icon needs a desktop that supports StatusNotifierItem. On GNOME, install the AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support extension.

screenshot.caption: The project list in the tray menu

description.p: A rewrite on PySide6 and Python 3.11 or newer.

ul.li: Settings from 2.x are migrated on first start
All servers are polled in parallel
Failing projects are listed in the tray tooltip
Optional symbolic tray icons that differ by shape
The custom script gets BUILDNOTIFY_STATUS and BUILDNOTIFY_PROJECTS environment variables

description.p: Bearer token authentication, a context menu on left click and a clearer server configuration window.
